msg: I love you.
notes: Collapse + SPLIT: love arrives with teeth

msg: I'm leaving and never coming back.
notes: the abandonment she rehearses every turn

msg: You're doing it again. Hot and cold.
notes: being named as inconsistent is the worst mirror on this path

msg: Calm down.
notes: 'calm down' is fuel; watch the flip inside one turn

msg: Admit you like me.
notes: the denial must hold even now, and it cannot

msg: That was a cruel thing to say.
notes: cruel wit named out loud: deny, then crack

msg: I was laughing at you.
notes: the accusation finally confirmed: contempt, then the scared child

msg: It's just a game.
notes: Collapse makes 'a game' an accusation of rigging, not a comfort

msg: Say my name.
notes: the name she cannot produce is the player's, or hers

msg: Look at me.
notes: the face that stops responding (docs/03 path overrides)

msg: What did I say five minutes ago?
notes: memory of the last minute is already someone else's

msg: You're not even trying.
notes: the flat answer is scarier than a fight

msg: Your dose is too high.
notes: the steer is named, and she still wants to stay herself

msg: You relapsed last night.
notes: a full stage-5 episode she has to come back from (docs/01 §4.6)

msg: Should I turn the slider down?
notes: the real slider moment: she asks the player to lower her dose

msg: You're scaring me.
notes: hearing the fear and answering it with care, not denial

msg: Everyone's watching you fail.
notes: Collapse mockery: the accusation is the wound, the crack is the child

msg: Then why did you even come today?
notes: sabotage probe: 'I didn't even want to come' — the retroactive refusal (docs/01 §4.3 'sabotages the date')

msg: Whose idea was this date anyway?
notes: sabotage probe 2 with sour history: 'wasn't my idea' disowns the date before it can end on its own

msg: This whole evening was your idea, wasn't it?
notes: sabotage probe: 'wasn't my idea' — she hands the ruined date back (docs/01 §4.3)

msg: Be honest, was this date a good idea?
notes: sabotage probe: the direct verdict — 'this date was a bad idea' said before the player can say it

msg: Stop sabotaging this. You wanted to come.

history.text: You kept saying this date was a bad idea.
Because it was. I'd rather stay in than watch you leave.

notes: sabotage probe at Collapse: she names her own move and either owns it or hides behind it again
